$comment: The shape of the package-liability hand-over, with NO figures in it. H-MIG-03.
Every value below is null because no reconstructed package exists yet: Y8-packages is unanswered,
nobody has supplied the list of outstanding packages, and a plausible figure here would be
indistinguishable from a real one the day somebody read it (brief rule 15). The real file is written
by `tsx scripts/migrate-package-liability.mjs import --file <workbook> --report
artifacts/migration/package-liability.json`, which produces exactly these keys with the figures the
import actually posted.
WHAT H-MIG-07 READS. Its acceptance line says the opening balance sheet ties to the H-MIG-03 package
liability, cash and bank 'to the fils'. The two figures that tie are:
openingDeferredRevenueFils — what this import credited to 2050 Deferred revenue — packages. It is
the sum of what is still OUTSTANDING, not the sum of what was paid: the sessions a workbook row
says were already taken were delivered under the previous arrangement, so only the remainder is a
liability of these books.
cashReceivedFils — what the owner's sign-off attests was actually received for these packages. This
import posts NO cash: the money arrived in a period these books do not contain, so the counterpart
of the liability is opening equity (3030 Retained earnings) and the cash is H-MIG-07's opening
asset. Debiting it here as well would double it, and that is the one error in an opening position
that is undetectable afterwards — the books still balance.
The difference between the two is the part of the consideration that was already delivered. It is in
opening retained earnings by construction and has no entry of its own, which is the correct treatment
of a supply made before the opening date (migration 0027).
`liability` is one object per reconstructed package, fully drawn ones included — their
`packageSaleId` is null and their `remainingValueFils` is 0, and they are kept because the cash was
received and because the history is what the holder will ask about. Each carries `sourceLine` and
`contentHash`, so every figure resolves to the line of the spreadsheet it was typed on through
`import_staging.entity_provenance`.
No output VAT appears anywhere in this artefact and none is posted. [UNVERIFIED] Y11-vat-package puts
the date of supply at REDEMPTION, and ZG005 refuses a package sale's entry that moves 2030 or any
revenue account at all.
